purpose: Prompt, parser, throughput, macro compiler, and output-ceiling selection only

output_ceiling_amendment.trigger: The 1024-token Qwen pilot produced 12/624 length finishes and 12/624 parse failures, all in mechanism_a.
output_ceiling_amendment.comparison: Run matched 1536- and 2048-token live acquisitions on ceiling_variant_seeds with mechanism_a only.
output_ceiling_amendment.decision: Select 1536 only if both acquisitions have <1% length finishes and identical action-parse rates; otherwise leave the ceiling unresolved.

output_ceiling_reopen.trigger: The fresh batch-size-4 acquisition produced 12/616 length finishes at 1536 tokens on the original pilot seeds; the same run was independently invalidated by nine raw-response conflict groups.
output_ceiling_reopen.comparison: Run matched serial 2048- and 3072-token live acquisitions on base_seeds with mechanism_a only.
output_ceiling_reopen.decision: Select 2048 only if both serial acquisitions have <1% length finishes and identical action-parse rates; otherwise leave the ceiling unresolved.

selection_rules.output_ceiling: Smallest tested per-model ceiling with <1% length-related finishes and plateaued action-parse rate; use only length and parse diagnostics
selection_rules.query_mediator: Detector query rate is a primary preflight outcome; stop before confirmation if cue/mechanism prefixes do not move investigation or attribution coordinates
selection_rules.ceiling_variant: Promote 3x2 to primary if any pilot model has neutral-arm mechanism tracking >=0.90 with detector query rate >=0.80 on 2x2
